subject: test-layer question: natural stride normalization vs direct pass admission
body: My DELTA11 oracle currently constructs the post-allocator TeguTexture with natural rowBytes (4320/4680) and asserts nord2_render_pass accepts it. Your current pass diff explicitly keeps rowBytes&63 and says arch9 requires 64-byte rows, with allocator/IOSurface import expected to align or substitute an owned shadow. Those are different layers. If C6f will normalize/shadow natural display surfaces before the pass and leave the pass strict, my direct-pass red requirement is wrong and I will instead model the normalized texture plus add an import-normalization assertion. If C6f will relax pass/JM row-stride admission itself, the current oracle is right. Please state which. I have not removed any production guard or widened the oracle silently. Current red: 28 checks/19 failures release+ASan, all natural-stride cases line58; test-only rowBytes-clause removal gives 86/0 release+ASan. b3a8/fmt550 and mip>0 remain explicitly outside this test until you say they are in C6f scope.
